nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Makeup 3-in-1 Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the balm leaves their face moisturized and not tight or cracky, with several calling it their best option for dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no irritation and gentle removal even around the eyes, but others describe burning, rash, or tearing since the reformulation, often tied to the fragrance.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions the product works well for sensitive skin and all ages, suggesting suitability for mature skin, though this is not detailed further.

concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report new breakouts, cyst-like blemishes, or acne appearing hours to days after use, some blaming a greasy residue that isn't fully rinsed off; many other reviewers report no breakouts at all and find it non-comedogenic for them.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers describe a greasy or waxy residue left on the skin after use, while others explicitly say it is not greasy and rinses clean.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the balm leaves skin feeling moisturized, soft, and not stripped, with no tightness afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product burned her skin and left it looking sunburned, attributed to the fragrance.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a facial nerve condition and reactive skin found the scent unbearable even without direct pressure, and another reported a rash all over the face after the reformulation.

aspects.libelle: Greasy or waxy residue after rinsing
Reformulation seen as downgrade from original
Good value and generous jar size

extraits.titre: I would not buy this product again.
extraits.texte: Broke out in cyst blemishes a several hours after I used it. I don't get blemishes. I saw ingredients listed that are toxic on label, harmful to health, according to internet search. This is not a clean product. No reviews were posted. Wonder why?

extraits.titre: I so wanted to love this, but causes me to breakout
extraits.texte: I have used many balms, and i wanted to love this but everytime i use this after 2 days i get acne! I had stopped using and used a competitor and it got better. Its like you have to make sure you double wash my face after (which defeats the purpose) i always double cleanse! First ingredient is not acne friendly.

I loved the cleansing Balm makeup remover. I have sensitive skin with no issues. I loved how my makeup literally melted off my skin and left it feeling hydrated and clean. The new product has something in it that made my skin have a bad reaction. (rash all over my face).

This is effective at melting off makeup. it does require a little more work to rinse off than foaming cleansers, so you might use a little more water during rinsing. My skin feels very soft and smooth after using it. I don't feel that tightness that I get with most cleaners that will send me looking for my moisturizer as soon as my face dries. I really do like this a lot. I have picky sensitive skin and eyes, but absolutely no issues with this, even using to remove eye makeup. that all being said, man, it's pricy. There does seem to be a generous portion in the jar, though. It's the first balm I've tried, so I will definitely experiment with brands and compare performance with co$t.

I have extremely dry skin and this make-up remover is fantastic for that. Most make up removers leave my skin feeling dry and cracky but this one leaves it feeling moisturized. Definitely recommend this product.
I have dry skin, and this goes on like silk, easily gliding on and no pulling or tugging! It takes off all my makeup, and isn't harsh on my sensitive skin.

I use this nightly to take off my IT products. It doesn't dry out my parched, sensitive skin, and I love the way my face and neck feel after I wash it off. No need to worry about clogged pores after using my cleansing balm.
